purpose: Challenge typed relative-context candidates while preserving accepted root/quote denotation and keeping production relative projection RAW.

currentBoundary.root: accepted recursive structural denotation with canonical inverse for its occurrence-tree subset
currentBoundary.relative: RAW only; no structural denotation is accepted

preservedVetoes: do not change root boundary orientation
do not merge quote and relative contexts
do not add a second raw parser
do not introduce persistent LinkRef/LinkId identity into L3
do not infer relative semantics from bracket spelling alone

contextCandidates.name: single-anchor
contextCandidates.openQuestion: whether one anchor is sufficient to distinguish both binary roles without adding hidden conventions

contextCandidates.name: ordered-start-end-anchors
contextCandidates.strength: makes the two binary roles explicit
contextCandidates.openQuestion: whether relative denotation is fundamentally binary-role contextual or this merely mirrors implementation convenience

contextCandidates.name: parented-binary-context
contextCandidates.strength: can model nested relative descriptions without overloading L2 ContextFrame
contextCandidates.openQuestion: whether parent ascent belongs to L3 relative denotation or should remain entirely outside the Anum carrier contract

contextCandidates.name: external-structural-denotation
contextCandidates.strength: context can itself be a storage-neutral described structure
contextCandidates.openQuestion: which node/ref inside the external structure acts as the relative anchor and whether that must be explicit

contextCandidates.name: persistent-linkref-context
contextCandidates.reason: L3 must remain storage-neutral; a persistent/backend link identity would couple denotation to L4

requiredContrasts: insufficient-context is typed failure rather than fallback guessing
context aliasing does not create storage identity
[[ and ]] remain unresolved unless an explicit rule is justified

releaseGate: choose one typed relative context model from executable evidence rather than implementation convenience
define relative meaning of accepted atoms/pairs and explicitly reject or defer the rest
define inverse inputs/results for the accepted subset
publish language-neutral positive and negative conformance
prove root and quote behavior unchanged
accept a versioned relative-denotation contract before production code changes
